## Type of Change

- [ ] Bug fix — broken link, typo, formatting issue
- [ ] Legal content update — statute change, new ruling, corrected information
- [ ] New content — new guide, new FAQ, new county coverage
- [ ] UI / styling improvement — HTML, CSS, or layout change

## Legal Accuracy Checklist

*(Complete this section for any PR that changes legal content)*

- [ ] All factual claims cite a primary source (statute, court opinion, or official agency)
- [ ] All links point to official `.gov` or `.ca.gov` sources where available
- [ ] California Penal Code sections are cited with correct section numbers
- [ ] Content does not constitute legal advice and includes the standard disclaimer
- [ ] Information reflects current California law as of the PR date

---

## Testing Checklist

- [ ] Tested in Chrome on desktop
- [ ] Tested in a mobile browser (or browser DevTools mobile view)
- [ ] All internal links resolve correctly
- [ ] All external links open in a new tab with `rel="noopener"`
- [ ] No console errors in the browser developer tools
- [ ] Page layout is not broken at 375px, 768px, and 1200px widths
- [ ] GitHub Actions deploy workflow passes
